capabilities: Group open todos into overdue, today and upcoming by planned date
Highlight long-overdue todos with Day N chips and deadline chips
Complete, reschedule, edit or cancel todos from the view with undo
Two-way sync changes between the view and the month notes
Filter todos by deadline, category or text
extras: The manifest description says "Korean UI and note format only" but the README says the UI follows the Obsidian language and notes can use English or Korean field names. Manifest carries an unreviewed-plugin warning. Korean field names are documented only in a separate Korean README. Requires Obsidian 1.13.0 or later; works on desktop and mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in view that collects todos scattered across monthly notes and shows overdue, today and upcoming items at a glance.

relations.evidence: To let AI agents such as Claude Code or Codex read and edit todos in the month note format

summary: Todo tracker that reads monthly Markdown notes and groups open todos into overdue, today and upcoming, syncing changes both ways.
